crossRefs.note: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.
The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.
and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.
When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory…

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.
translations.bsb: Joseph replied, “This is the interpretation: The three baskets are three days.
translations.kjv: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:
translations.asv: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: the three baskets are three days;
